theorems.name: Submission.rpn_null_compact_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Eucl N)), IsCompact F → (volume : Measure (Eucl N)) F = 0 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ b y ∧ b y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ F, b y = 1) ∧ ((volume : Measure (Eucl N)) (tsupport b)).toReal ≤ δ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
